sections.heading: What an SPV is
sections.content: It is a single-vehicle investment into one company: the investor raises money from LPs or other investors specifically to invest in that company. The discussion also notes that SPVs can provide deal-by-deal carry and let the investor bring strategic, helpful people into the company’s round; raising for each SPV can be time-consuming.
